course.subtitle_en: Twenty-nine lessons on how to evaluate an industry, a business, its price, and your own judgment — then hold it inside a portfolio.
course.subtitle_zh: 二十九課：怎麼評估一個產業、一門生意、它的價格、你自己的判斷——再把它放進一個組合。

parts.q_en: What is the framework, and what language does it speak?
parts.q_zh: 這套框架是什麼？它用什麼語言說話？

parts.en: Part I · Where Returns Come From
parts.zh: 第一部・報酬從哪裡來
parts.q_en: Does the industry let anyone earn good returns — and for how long?
parts.q_zh: 這個產業讓不讓人賺到好報酬？能賺多久？

parts.en: Part II · What a Good Business Looks Like
parts.zh: 第二部・好生意長什麼樣
parts.q_en: Does this company earn more than its cost of capital, and can it keep doing so?
parts.q_zh: 這家公司賺得比資金成本多嗎？能一直這樣嗎？

parts.en: Part III · How the Market Prices It
parts.zh: 第三部・市場怎麼定價
parts.q_en: What does today's price already assume — and how does the price feed back into the business?
parts.q_zh: 今天的價格已經假設了什麼？價格又怎麼反過來影響生意？

parts.q_en: How do you weigh evidence, build a falsifiable view, and know when you are wrong?
parts.q_zh: 怎麼秤證據、怎麼建立一個能被證偽的看法、怎麼知道自己錯了？

parts.en: Part V · From One Stock to a Portfolio
parts.zh: 第五部・從一檔股票到一個組合
parts.q_en: How much of it, next to what else, under which rules?
parts.q_zh: 買多少？和什麼放在一起？用什麼規則管？

parts.q_en: The whole framework on one page.
